description: Run Playwright tests and return structured results.

env.description: Environment variable overrides for the Playwright child process. Each key must be listed in PW_ALLOWED_ENV. Dangerous names (NODE_*, NPM_CONFIG_*, PATH, proxies, secrets) are always rejected. Values are never echoed in get_run_status.

headed.description: Run with a visible browser window. Omitting or setting false leaves playwright.config.ts intact — Playwright has no --no-headed flag, so false does not force headless when the config sets headed.

maxFailures.description: Stop the run after this many failures.

retries.description: Maximum retry count for flaky tests; 0 disables retries.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the whole test run. Defaults to 300000.

trace.description: Force Playwright tracing mode, overriding playwright.config.ts.

updateSnapshots.description: Update snapshot baselines. Playwright default is "missing"; "changed" updates differing + missing.

wait.description: Wait for completion before returning. Defaults to true. Set false to start a background run and poll it with get_run_status.

workingDirectory.description: Playwright project directory. Absolute or relative to the MCP server launch directory. Defaults to ".". Must be under PW_ALLOWED_DIRS.

name: run_tests
